title: Job
description: One typed job sent with run or validate. This schema covers the job's structure. Each op's args are checked against the op schemas built into the engine (list them with `sa ops --json`); `sa job lint` runs both checks offline.

jobId.description: Unique forever; a repeat is refused with duplicate_job

document.description: Copied from the snapshot. A mismatch gives wrong_document or document_changed and nothing runs

standard.description: Path of the project standard file

ownership.description: Revit worksharing. refuse (default): the job is refused with not_owned if any existing element it would change is owned by someone else or changed in central. skip: those elements are left out of every op, each is reported, and the rest of the job runs

checksFile.description: Checks file or folder (every *.json inside), or a list, defining the ids in checks. Replaces the bundled checks unless checksMode is add

visual.description: Capture target before the first op and after the last, compare the pixels and report check visual.diff (FORMATS.md section 7)

window.description: AutoCAD model target only: the model window [[x1, y1], [x2, y2]] in drawing units

pixelWidth.description: Revit only: image width in pixels

maxUnexpectedChange.description: Largest fraction of the image's pixels that may change outside the expected region

threshold.description: Per-channel difference (0-255) below which a pixel counts as unchanged

padding.description: Pixels added around each touched element's extents

expectChange.description: true: the view must change; false: nothing may change; left out: must change when the job created elements that should show
